seed.label: Seed
seed.hint: The randomizer seed. Leave blank to use a random seed.

dataset_length.label: Dataset Length
dataset_length.hint: The amount of signals contained in the dataset.

location.label: Save Location
location.hint: The folder the dataset is written into, on the machine running the server. Use a full path; ~ is the home folder of the account running the server.

filename.label: Dataset Name
filename.hint: The name of the dataset folder created inside the save location.

overwrite.label: Overwrite
overwrite.hint: Whether to replace an existing TorchSig dataset with the same name in the save location. Folders that are not TorchSig datasets are never replaced.

multithreading.label: Multithreading
multithreading.hint: Whether to use multithreading while generating the dataset.
